---
title: "Fig. 1 - Primary follicle length"
author: "gavingeddes"
date: "2026-03-22"
output: html_document
---
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Mean follicle length per individual:
# - reads already-averaged per-individual data from CSV
# - plots Short day vs Long day
# - species side-by-side within each photoperiod
# - runs two-way ANOVA: Species * Photoperiod
# - runs Tukey-adjusted post hoc comparisons
# - adds Tukey letter groupings onto the figure
# ============================================================

# ---- 0. Install packages if needed ----
packages <- c(
  "dplyr", "ggplot2", "stringr",
  "emmeans", "multcomp", "multcompView", "ragg"
)
to_install <- packages[!packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

# ---- 1. Load libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(ragg)

# ---- 2. Read individual means CSV (already averaged per individual) ----
indiv_means <- read.csv("Follicle_IndividualMeans.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Set factor levels for consistent ordering/plotting
indiv_means <- indiv_means %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Cx. pipiens", "Cx. quinquefasciatus")),
    Photoperiod = factor(Photoperiod, levels = c("9L:15D", "15L:9D"))
  )

cat("\n===== SAMPLE SIZES (individuals) =====\n")
print(table(indiv_means$Photoperiod, indiv_means$Species))

# ---- 3. Summary stats for reporting ----
# Includes a count of individuals per group with a mean follicle length > 75 um
summary_stats <- indiv_means %>%
  group_by(Photoperiod, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    n_individuals = n(),
    mean = mean(Mean_Follicle_Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Mean_Follicle_Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd / sqrt(n_individuals),
    median = median(Mean_Follicle_Length, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_over_75um = sum(Mean_Follicle_Length > 75, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_over_75um = round(100 * n_over_75um / n_individuals, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n===== SUMMARY STATISTICS =====\n")
print(summary_stats)

# ---- Export descriptive statistics ----
write.csv(summary_stats, "Follicle_SummaryStats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 4. Two-way ANOVA ----
anova_model <- aov(Mean_Follicle_Length ~ Species * Photoperiod, data = indiv_means)

cat("\n===== TWO-WAY ANOVA =====\n")
print(summary(anova_model))

# ---- 5. Tukey-adjusted post hoc tests using estimated marginal means ----
emm <- emmeans(anova_model, ~ Species * Photoperiod)

cat("\n===== EMMEANS =====\n")
print(emm)

cat("\n===== TUKEY PAIRWISE COMPARISONS =====\n")
tukey_pairs <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")
print(tukey_pairs)

# Save pairwise comparisons table
tukey_table <- as.data.frame(tukey_pairs)
write.csv(tukey_table, "Tukey_pairwise_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 6. Compact letter display for figure annotation ----
# Groups sharing a letter are not significantly different
cld_df <- cld(emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Clean letter labels
cld_df$.group <- gsub(" ", "", cld_df$.group)

# Make sure factor levels match plotting data
cld_df$Species <- factor(
  cld_df$Species,
  levels = levels(indiv_means$Species)
)
cld_df$Photoperiod <- factor(
  cld_df$Photoperiod,
  levels = levels(indiv_means$Photoperiod)
)

# Set y-position for letters above each box
label_pos <- indiv_means %>%
  group_by(Photoperiod, Species) %>%
  summarise(
    y = max(Mean_Follicle_Length, na.rm = TRUE) + 7,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cld_df <- left_join(cld_df, label_pos, by = c("Photoperiod", "Species"))

cat("\n===== TUKEY LETTER GROUPS =====\n")
print(cld_df[, c("Species", "Photoperiod", "emmean", ".group")])

# ---- 6b. Build "n over 75 um / total n" ratio labels (like Fig. 2) ----
# Placed just below the significance letters, above the boxes
ratio_labels <- summary_stats %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_label = paste0("(", n_over_75um, "/", n_individuals, ")")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Photoperiod, Species, ratio_label) %>%
  left_join(
    label_pos %>% mutate(y_ratio = y - 3.5) %>% dplyr::select(-y),
    by = c("Photoperiod", "Species")
  )

# ---- 7. Plot ----
p <- ggplot(
  indiv_means,
  aes(x = Photoperiod, y = Mean_Follicle_Length, fill = Species)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.10,
      dodge.width = 0.75
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.75,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = cld_df,
    aes(
      x = Photoperiod,
      y = y,
      label = .group,
      group = Species
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ratio_labels,
    aes(
      x = Photoperiod,
      y = y_ratio,
      label = ratio_label,
      group = Species
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 75,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray70"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Cx. pipiens" = "white",
      "Cx. quinquefasciatus" = "gray60"
    ),
    # Italic species names in the legend (order matches factor levels)
    labels = c(
      expression(italic("Cx. pipiens")),
      expression(italic("Cx. quinquefasciatus"))
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "9L:15D" = "Short day",
      "15L:9D" = "Long day"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Primary follicle length (\u00b5m)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      min(indiv_means$Mean_Follicle_Length, na.rm = TRUE) - 2,
      max(cld_df$y, na.rm = TRUE) + 4
    )
  )

print(p)

# ---- 8. Save outputs ----
# ragg device renders italic faces reliably across systems
ggsave(
  "Follicle_Boxplot_IndividualMeans_TwoWayANOVA_Tukey.png",
  p,
  device = ragg::agg_png,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 800
)

ggsave(
  "Follicle_Boxplot_IndividualMeans_TwoWayANOVA_Tukey.pdf",
  p,
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)

write.csv(summary_stats, "Follicle_SummaryStats.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cld_df, "Follicle_TukeyLetterGroups.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nFiles saved:\n")
cat(" - Follicle_Boxplot_IndividualMeans_TwoWayANOVA_Tukey.png\n")
cat(" - Follicle_Boxplot_IndividualMeans_TwoWayANOVA_Tukey.pdf\n")
cat(" - Follicle_SummaryStats.csv\n")
cat(" - Follicle_TukeyLetterGroups.csv\n")
cat(" - Tukey_pairwise_results.csv\n")
```
